of this item!

PokemonHpRestoreModifierType.description: Restores {{restorePoints}} HP or {{restorePercent}}% HP for one Pokémon, whichever is higher.

extra.fully: Fully restores HP for one Pokémon.
extra.fullyWithStatus: Fully restores HP for one Pokémon and heals any status ailment.

PokemonReviveModifierType.description: Revives one Pokémon and restores {{restorePercent}}% HP.

PokemonStatusHealModifierType.description: Heals any status ailment for one Pokémon.

PokemonPpRestoreModifierType.description: Restores {{restorePoints}} PP for one Pokémon move.

extra.fully: Restores all PP for one Pokémon move.

PokemonAllMovePpRestoreModifierType.description: Restores {{restorePoints}} PP for all of one Pokémon’s moves.

extra.fully: Restores all PP for all of one Pokémon’s moves.

PokemonPpUpModifierType.description: Permanently increases PP for one Pokémon move by {{upPoints}} for every 5 maximum PP (maximum 3).

PokemonNatureChangeModifierType.name: {{natureName}} Mint
PokemonNatureChangeModifierType.description: Changes a Pokémon’s nature to {{natureName}} and permanently unlocks the nature for the starter.

PokeblockModifierType.descriptionAll: Raises all of one Pokemon's contest conditions by {{amount}}.

DoubleBattleChanceBoosterModifierType.description: Quadruples the chance of an encounter being a double battle for up to {{battleCount}} battles.

TempStatStageBoosterModifierType.description: Increases the {{stat}} of all party members by {{amount}} for up to 5 battles.

AttackTypeBoosterModifierType.description: Increases the power of a Pokémon’s {{moveType}}-type moves by 20%.

TypeGemModifierType.description: Boosts the holder's next damaging {{moveType}}-type move by {{boostPercent}}%, then is consumed.

AllPokemonLevelIncrementModifierType.description: Increases all party members’ level by {{levels}}.

BaseStatBoosterModifierType.description: Increases the holder’s base {{stat}} by 10%. The higher your IVs, the higher the stack limit.

PokemonBaseStatFlatModifierType.name: Old Gateau
PokemonBaseStatFlatModifierType.description: Increases the holder’s {{stats}} base stats by {{statValue}}. Found after a strange dream.

AllPokemonFullReviveModifierType.description: Revives all fainted Pokémon, fully restoring HP.

ExpBoosterModifierType.description: Increases gain of EXP. Points by {{boostPercent}}%.

PokemonExpBoosterModifierType.description: Increases the holder’s gain of EXP. Points by {{boostPercent}}%.

PokemonMultiHitModifierType.description: Converts 25% of damage from the holder’s attacks into an additional strike.

TmModifierTypeWithInfo.name: TM{{moveId}} - {{moveName}}
TmModifierTypeWithInfo.description:
Teach {{moveName}} to a Pokémon
(Hold C or Shift for more info).

FormChangeItemModifierType.description: Causes certain Pokémon to change form.

FusePokemonModifierType.description: Combines two Pokémon (transfers Ability, splits base stats and types, shares move pool).

TerastallizeModifierType.name: {{teraType}} Tera Shard
TerastallizeModifierType.description: Changes the Pokémon’s Tera type to {{teraType}}.

ContactHeldItemTransferChanceModifierTyp.description: Upon attacking, there is a {{chancePercent}}% chance the foe’s held item will be stolen.

TurnHeldItemTransferModifierType.description: Every turn, the holder acquires one held item from the foe.

EnemyAttackStatusEffectChanceModifierTyp.description: Adds a {{chancePercent}}% chance to inflict {{statusEffect}} with attack moves.

EnemyEndureChanceModifierType.description: Adds a {{chancePercent}}% chance of enduring a hit.

TERA_ORB.name: Tera Orb
TERA_ORB.description: Allows your Pokémon to Terastallize. Recharges slowly. Tera Shards also become available.

Z_RING.name: Z-Ring
Z_RING.description: Allows Pokemon holding a Z-Crystal to use a Z-Move. The Z-Ring recharges every 15 waves. Z-Crystals also become available.

ALORAICHIUM_Z.name: Aloraichium Z
ALORAICHIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to use a compatible Z-Move when you have a Z-Ring.

BUGINIUM_Z.name: Buginium Z
BUGINIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Bug-type move into a Z-Move.

DARKINIUM_Z.name: Darkinium Z
DARKINIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Dark-type move into a Z-Move.

DECIDIUM_Z.name: Decidium Z
DECIDIUM_Z.description: Allows Decidueye to upgrade Spirit Shackle into Sinister Arrow Raid.

DRAGONIUM_Z.name: Dragonium Z
DRAGONIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Dragon-type move into a Z-Move.

EEVIUM_Z.name: Eevium Z
EEVIUM_Z.description: Allows Eevee to upgrade Last Resort into Extreme Evoboost.

ELECTRIUM_Z.name: Electrium Z
ELECTRIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Electric-type move into a Z-Move.

FAIRIUM_Z.name: Fairium Z
FAIRIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Fairy-type move into a Z-Move.

FIGHTINIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Fighting-type move into a Z-Move.

FIRIUM_Z.name: Firium Z
FIRIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Fire-type move into a Z-Move.

FLYINIUM_Z.name: Flyinium Z
FLYINIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Flying-type move into a Z-Move.

GHOSTIUM_Z.name: Ghostium Z
GHOSTIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Ghost-type move into a Z-Move.

GRASSIUM_Z.name: Grassium Z
GRASSIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Grass-type move into a Z-Move.

GROUNDIUM_Z.name: Groundium Z
GROUNDIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Ground-type move into a Z-Move.

ICIUM_Z.name: Icium Z
ICIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Ice-type move into a Z-Move.

INCINIUM_Z.name: Incinium Z
INCINIUM_Z.description: Allows Incineroar to upgrade Darkest Lariat into Malicious Moonsault.

KOMMONIUM_Z.name: Kommonium Z
KOMMONIUM_Z.description: Allows Kommo-o to upgrade Clanging Scales into Clangorous Soulblaze.

LUNALIUM_Z.name: Lunalium Z
LUNALIUM_Z.description: Allows Lunala or Necrozma to upgrade Moongeist Beam into Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom.

LYCANIUM_Z.name: Lycanium Z
LYCANIUM_Z.description: Allows Lycanroc to upgrade Stone Edge into Splintered Stormshards.

MARSHADIUM_Z.name: Marshadium Z
MARSHADIUM_Z.description: Allows Marshadow to upgrade Spectral Thief into Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike.

MEWNIUM_Z.name: Mewnium Z
MEWNIUM_Z.description: Allows Mew to upgrade Psychic into Genesis Supernova.

MIMIKIUM_Z.name: Mimikium Z
MIMIKIUM_Z.description: Allows Mimikyu to upgrade Play Rough into Let's Snuggle Forever.

NORMALIUM_Z.name: Normalium Z
NORMALIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Normal-type move into a Z-Move.

PIKANIUM_Z.name: Pikanium Z
PIKANIUM_Z.description: Allows Pikachu to upgrade Volt Tackle into Catastropika.

PIKASHUNIUM_Z.name: Pikashunium Z
PIKASHUNIUM_Z.description: Allows Pikachu in a cap to upgrade Thunderbolt into 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt.

POISONIUM_Z.name: Poisonium Z
POISONIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Poison-type move into a Z-Move.

PRIMARIUM_Z.name: Primarium Z
PRIMARIUM_Z.description: Allows Primarina to upgrade Sparkling Aria into Oceanic Operetta.

PSYCHIUM_Z.name: Psychium Z
PSYCHIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Psychic-type move into a Z-Move.

ROCKIUM_Z.name: Rockium Z
ROCKIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Rock-type move into a Z-Move.

SNORLIUM_Z.name: Snorlium Z
SNORLIUM_Z.description: Allows Snorlax to upgrade Giga Impact into Pulverizing Pancake.

SOLGANIUM_Z.name: Solganium Z
SOLGANIUM_Z.description: Allows Solgaleo or Necrozma to upgrade Sunsteel Strike into Searing Sunraze Smash.

STEELIUM_Z.name: Steelium Z
STEELIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Steel-type move into a Z-Move.

TAPUNIUM_Z.name: Tapunium Z
TAPUNIUM_Z.description: Allows a guardian deity to upgrade Nature's Madness into Guardian of Alola.

ULTRANECROZIUM_Z.name: Ultranecrozium Z
ULTRANECROZIUM_Z.description: Allows Necrozma to upgrade Photon Geyser into Light That Burns the Sky.

WATERIUM_Z.name: Waterium Z
WATERIUM_Z.description: Allows the holder to upgrade a compatible Water-type move into a Z-Move.

MAP.name: Map
MAP.description: Allows you to choose your destination at a crossroads.

OLD_SEA_MAP.name: Old Sea Map
OLD_SEA_MAP.description: A faded old hand drawn map. Surprisingly accurate, save for one extra location in the ocean.

LINKING_CORD_GOLD.name: Linking Cord Gold
LINKING_CORD_GOLD.description: Allows players to trade Pokemon with each other from the rewards screen.

REVIVER_SEED.name: Reviver Seed
REVIVER_SEED.description: Revives the holder for 1/2 HP upon fainting from a direct hit.

WHITE_HERB.name: White Herb
WHITE_HERB.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It will restore any lowered stat in battle.

POKEBLOCK_KIT.name: Pokeblock Kit
POKEBLOCK_KIT.description: Adds a 15% chance per stack for one Pokeblock to appear in reward choices. Stacks up to 5.

EXP_SHARE.name: EXP. All
EXP_SHARE.description: Non-participants receive 20% of a single participant’s EXP. Points.

EXP_BALANCE.name: EXP. Balance
EXP_BALANCE.description: Weighs EXP. Points received from battles towards lower-leveled party members.

OVAL_CHARM.name: Oval Charm
OVAL_CHARM.description: When multiple Pokémon participate in a battle, each gets an extra 10% of the total EXP.

SCOPE_LENS.name: Scope Lens
SCOPE_LENS.description: It’s a lens for scoping out weak points. It boosts the holder’s critical-hit ratio.

LEEK.name: Leek
LEEK.description: This very long and stiff stalk of leek boosts the critical-hit ratio of Farfetch’d’s moves.

EVIOLITE.name: Eviolite
EVIOLITE.description: This mysterious evolutionary lump boosts the Defense and Sp. Def stats when held by a Pokémon that can still evolve.

SOUL_DEW.name: Soul Dew
SOUL_DEW.description: Increases the influence of a Pokémon’s nature on its stats by 10% (additive).

GOLDEN_PUNCH.name: Golden Punch
GOLDEN_PUNCH.description: Grants 50% of direct damage inflicted as money.

COIN_CASE.name: Coin Case
COIN_CASE.description: After every 10th battle, receive 10% of your money in interest.

LOCK_CAPSULE.name: Lock Capsule
LOCK_CAPSULE.description: Allows you to lock item rarities when rerolling items.

LOADED_DICE.name: Loaded Dice
LOADED_DICE.description: Makes moves that normally hit 2 to 5 times hit at least 4 times.

UNOWN_BOX.name: Unown Box
UNOWN_BOX.description: Allows Unown to find Unown tiles after battles.

HEALING_CHARM.name: Healing Charm
HEALING_CHARM.description: Increases the effectiveness of HP restoring moves and items by 10% (excludes Revives).

CANDY_JAR.name: Candy Jar
CANDY_JAR.description: Increases the number of levels added by Rare Candy items by 1.

BERRY_POUCH.name: Berry Pouch
BERRY_POUCH.description: Adds a 30% chance that a used berry will not be consumed.

BERRY_POT.name: Berry Pot
BERRY_POT.description: Produces berries for a Pokemon with Symbiosis. More stacks grow berries faster.

FOCUS_BAND.name: Focus Band
FOCUS_BAND.description: Adds a 10% chance to survive with 1 HP after being damaged enough to faint.

QUICK_CLAW.name: Quick Claw
QUICK_CLAW.description: Adds a 10% chance to move first regardless of speed (after priority).

KINGS_ROCK.name: King’s Rock
KINGS_ROCK.description: Adds a 10% chance an attack move will cause the opponent to flinch.

LEFTOVERS.name: Leftovers
LEFTOVERS.description: Heals 1/16 of a Pokémon’s maximum HP every turn.

SHELL_BELL.name: Shell Bell
SHELL_BELL.description: Heals 1/8 of a Pokémon’s dealt damage.

TOXIC_ORB.name: Toxic Orb
TOXIC_ORB.description: It’s a bizarre orb that exudes toxins when touched and will badly poison the holder during battle.

FLAME_ORB.name: Flame Orb
FLAME_ORB.description: It’s a bizarre orb that gives off heat when touched and will affect the holder with a burn during battle.

MYSTICAL_ROCK.name: Mystical Rock
MYSTICAL_ROCK.description: Extends the duration of terrain and weather caused by the holder’s moves or Abilities by 2 turns.

STICKY_BARBS.name: Sticky Barb
STICKY_BARBS.description: Damages the holder every turn. If the holder is hit by a contact move, damages the attacker and moves to them.

LAGGING_TAIL.name: Lagging Tail
LAGGING_TAIL.description: Lowers the holder's move priority by 1.

IRON_BALL.name: Iron Ball
IRON_BALL.description: Grounds the holder, removing Flying and Levitate immunity to Ground-type attacks.

LIGHT_CLAY.name: Light Clay
LIGHT_CLAY.description: Extends the duration of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil caused by the holder's moves by 2 turns.

MIRROR_HERB.name: Mirror Herb
MIRROR_HERB.description: Copies an opponent's stat increases once, then is consumed.

EVOLUTION_TRACKER_GIMMIGHOUL.name: Treasures
EVOLUTION_TRACKER_GIMMIGHOUL.description: This Pokémon loves treasure! Keep collecting treasure and something might happen!

EVOLUTION_TRACKER_PRIMEAPE.name: Rage Fist
EVOLUTION_TRACKER_PRIMEAPE.description:
Primeape evolves when its rage surpasses the limits of its physical form!
Build up its rage by using the move Rage Fist!

EVOLUTION_TRACKER_STANTLER.name: Psyshield Bash
EVOLUTION_TRACKER_STANTLER.description: Stantler evolves to adapt to harsh environments. Toughen up its defense by using the move Psyshield Bash!

BATON.name: Baton
BATON.description: Allows passing along effects when switching Pokémon, which also bypasses traps.

SHINY_CHARM.name: Shiny Charm
SHINY_CHARM.description: Dramatically increases the chance of a wild Pokémon being Shiny.

SHINY_BADGE.name: Shiny Badge
SHINY_BADGE.description: The holder appears as one of its Shiny variants without adding it to the Pokédex.

ABILITY_CHARM.name: Ability Charm
ABILITY_CHARM.description: Dramatically increases the chance of a wild Pokémon having a Hidden Ability.

CATCHING_CHARM.name: Catching Charm
CATCHING_CHARM.description: Increases the chance of getting a critical catch.

IV_SCANNER.name: IV Scanner
IV_SCANNER.description: Enables scanning the IVs of wild Pokémon.

EON_FLUTE.name: Eon Flute
EON_FLUTE.description: Calls in backup when you would otherwise fail

GLASS_BALL.name: Glass Ball
GLASS_BALL.description: Calls in a mysterious backup helper when you would otherwise fail.

GRAND_LAUREL.name: Grand Laurel
GRAND_LAUREL.description: Boosts each party Pokémon's HP, Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, and Sp. Def based on its contest conditions.

GAMMA_RAY_BURST.name: Gamma Ray Burst
GAMMA_RAY_BURST.description: Destroys one of the holder's other eligible held items at the end of each turn to generate permanent stat boosts.

GOLDEN_POKEBALL.name: Golden Poké Ball
GOLDEN_POKEBALL.description: Adds 1 extra item option at the end of every battle.

ENEMY_HEAL.name: Recovery Token
ENEMY_HEAL.description: Heals 2% of max HP every turn.

ENEMY_STATUS_EFFECT_HEAL_CHANCE.name: Full Heal Token
ENEMY_STATUS_EFFECT_HEAL_CHANCE.description: Adds a 2.5% chance every turn to heal a status condition.

ENEMY_FUSED_CHANCE.name: Fusion Token
ENEMY_FUSED_CHANCE.description: Adds a 1% chance that a wild Pokémon will be a fusion.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_SHUCKLE_JUICE_GOOD.name: Sweet Shuckle Juice
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_SHUCKLE_JUICE_GOOD.description: Increases all of the holder’s base stats. You were blessed by the Shuckle.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_SHUCKLE_JUICE_BAD.name: Foul Shuckle Juice
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_SHUCKLE_JUICE_BAD.description: Decreases all of the holder’s base stats. You were cursed by the Shuckle.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_BLACK_SLUDGE.name: Black Sludge
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_BLACK_SLUDGE.description: The stench is so powerful that shops will only sell you items at a steep cost increase.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_MACHO_BRACE.name: Macho Brace
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_MACHO_BRACE.description: Defeating a Pokémon grants the holder a stack of it. Each stack boosts stats a bit. Bonus at max stacks.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_OLD_GATEAU.name: Old Gateau
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_OLD_GATEAU.description: Increases some of the holder’s stats.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_GOLDEN_BUG_NET.name: Golden Bug Net
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_GOLDEN_BUG_NET.description: Imbues the owner with luck to find Bug Type Pokémon more often. Has a strange heft to it.

LIGHT_BALL.name: Light Ball
LIGHT_BALL.description: It’s a mysterious orb that boosts Pikachu’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

THICK_CLUB.name: Thick Club
THICK_CLUB.description: This hard bone of unknown origin boosts Cubone or Marowak’s Attack stat.

METAL_POWDER.name: Metal Powder
METAL_POWDER.description: Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts Ditto’s Defense stat.

QUICK_POWDER.name: Quick Powder
QUICK_POWDER.description: Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts Ditto’s Speed stat.

DEEP_SEA_SCALE.name: Deep Sea Scale
DEEP_SEA_SCALE.description: This scale shines with a faint pink and boosts Clamperl’s Sp. Def stat.

DEEP_SEA_TOOTH.name: Deep Sea Tooth
DEEP_SEA_TOOTH.description: This fang gleams a sharp silver and boosts Clamperl’s Sp. Atk stat.
